# 4 bed house for sale

> DNG Boyce Gallagher are delighted to present to market this exceptional A1-rated detached family residence situated in the peaceful rural townland of Prucklish, Churchill, Co. Donegal. Completed in 2025 and finished to an exceptional standard throughout, this impressive four-bedroom family home occupies a beautifully maintained site with a fully concrete driveway and detached garage.

## Fakta
- Typ: house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 213 m²
- Energetická náročnost: A1
- Lokalita: Prucklish, Church Hill, Letterkenny
- Cena: 635 000 €
